V3REUSABLE PRESENTATION SYSTEM

Start a new story
in motion.

Two ways to begin: build each page from a blank canvas with only cinematic movement and reveals, or adapt five ready-made example scenes. Both use one shared Forward Story v3 engine. No ZIP required.

01 / DEFAULT · BLANK CANVAS

Start with a blank page

Keep the 4.2-second camera transitions and progressive element reveals. Choose the story, layout, assets and interactions page by page. Route, traveler and palette are optional.

Open Blank Canvas ↗ 02 / EXPLORE EXAMPLES

Explore five example pages

See editorial layouts, a connected diagram, a working Before/After interaction and a closing scene. Adapt what is useful without adopting a fixed page structure.

Open Example Template ↗

Both modes share one portable source package and the same motion engine. Copy the full folder to a new project; for Blank Canvas, replace the new project's index.html with blank.html.

Starting with Codex?

Copy the instruction below into any new project chat.

Start a NEW presentation with the Forward Story v3 reusable template:
https://github.com/proxima-j/stray-kitty-presentation/tree/main/docs/templates/forward-story-v3

Default starting mode: BLANK CANVAS. Read README.md, WORKFLOW.md,
SCENE-RECIPES.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and the asset manifest.
Copy the ENTIRE template folder into my NEW repository, then copy
blank.html over index.html in that NEW folder (do not change the source repository).

Keep the shared 4.2-second reversible camera/scene engine, scroll navigation,
and data-build/data-at element reveals. Choose the new project's page count,
story, layouts, media, colors and typography through discussion; no example
composition is mandatory. Route and traveler start hidden, but may be enabled
independently via body data-route and data-traveler. Customize the neutral
palette via styles/blank.css without editing the global motion engine.

If I explicitly choose EXAMPLE MODE instead, keep the five-scene index.html
and adapt its layouts. Do not create a separate animation engine.

First discuss the audience, presentation story and section outline. Develop
one page's content and assets at a time: isolated review → approval →
native integration → focused verification → normal publication.
Preserve source provenance and Current/Previous in the original Stray Kitty
repository. Never modify those original working decks.
Generic assets and licensed font only · Production content stays in its original repositoryOpen Notion reference ↗
